dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

nxReleaseVersionData.description: Versions nx release set in this run, a project it left unversioned is skipped

programs.description: Program packages, each resolved from the project and exporting stacks(request)

request.description: What the run asks each program's stacks for: a local install, a deploy, or a released version

stack.description: Name of the one stack a deploy applies, absent applies every stack

destroy.description: Destroys the stacks of a deploy and removes them

title: Stacks
description: Applies the stacks a program package states for a project through the Pulumi Automation API, refreshing live state first, previewing a release under a dry run
